node_1.subject: Dolores Abernathy
node_1.description: This is Dolores Abernathy's plan for Monday February 13: wake up and complete the morning routine at 7:00am, have breakfast and walk to Hobbs Cafe from 7:00 am to 8:00 am, work at Hobbs Cafe from 8:00 am to 4:00 pm, walk back to the dorm and read in her room from 4:00 pm to 6:00 pm, have dinner at the dorm at 6:00 pm, read and work on the computer in her room from 7:00 pm to 11:00 pm, go to bed at 11:00 pm.
